newsitem.title: ISRAEL: ISRAEL'S JULY TRADE DEFICIT NARROWS TO $473 MLN.
newsitem.headline: ISRAEL'S JULY TRADE DEFICIT NARROWS TO $473 MLN.

text.p: Israel's trade deficit in July totalled $473 million, down from $748 million in June, the Central Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
Note - Figures are in millions of dollars.
July's deficit was the smallest since September 1995.
The bureau said imports in July remained stable after declining from March 1996 to February 1997. As for exports, despite July's increase the overall trend is one of decline, the bureau said.
In the first seven months of the year the trade deficit shrunk to $4.725 billion from $6.425 billion in the same period a year earlier.
